items.analysis: Finite M is used to prove the set of all R-linear endomorphisms finite via injection into M->M; R itself need not be finite or commutative. A repeated power yields n and strictly positive p. k=n*p is proved >=n, including n=0. projection_eq_uniform_power identifies this actual power with the canonical projection. Idempotence, kernel=nilpart, range=periodicpart and a genuine linear equivalence M ≃ N×P follow, with nilpart/periodicpart proved submodules from actual orbit powers.

The four actual endomorphisms are (1-eT)(1-eU), (1-eT)eU, eT(1-eU), eT eU indexed by Bool×Bool. Commutation of the canonical projections is derived from two uses of naturality, so the finite-module specialization is valid without assuming arbitrary chosen projections commute. four_idempotent/four_orthogonal/four_sum prove all requested algebraic identities; range_product and part_range identify each actual range with the exact N/P intersection. four_decomposition and four_components_unique give existence and uniqueness of all four components, not merely pairwise disjoint submodules. four_natural quantifies over arbitrary simultaneous same-ring intertwiners.

PointwiseFiniteOrbit is literally finiteness of Set.range(n↦T^n x), with no finite-generation or common-period hypothesis. The source constructs each periodic-tail component from a repeated orbit, then proves its uniqueness using N∩P=0. projection linearity is established by uniqueness, not stored as a solution certificate. All kernel/range/idempotence/actual linear direct-sum equivalence claims are proved. periodic_restriction_bijective handles arbitrary positive periods and constructs an actual inverse linear equivalence. projection_characterization gives uniqueness against any proposed R-linear projection satisfying both membership clauses, and projection_natural includes all intertwiners. Ring R may be noncommutative.

CounterSpace=(Nat→₀ZMod2)×ZMod2 uses genuine finite support, and shift_locally_nilpotent proves eventual zero for each shift component from its support maximum. backward_finite proves the full orbit set finite. The canonical projection is explicitly computed as (0,c). Crucially polynomial_coefficient applies the ACTUAL aeval backward p to each basis vector e_k and reads p.coeff k at coordinate zero, for every polynomial p and every k. If p(T)=e, all coefficients vanish, then evaluation on the nonzero fixed extra coordinate contradicts p=0. Thus all finite polynomials, including zero and arbitrary-degree nonmonomials, are excluded.

twice is the actual Q-linear map 2I on Q. Every orbit span is a subspace of the one-dimensional Q-space and hence is finite-dimensional. twice_pow computes all powers, twice_nil proves N=0, twice_periodic excludes all strictly positive periods by 2^p>1, and twice_not_decomposable uses the nonzero vector 1. No finiteness of the orbit SET is inserted.

Both directions of the exact minpoly criterion are established. A decomposition is first proved equivalent to actual pointwise finite orbits; in finite dimension, a finite basis embeds the entire power family into a finite product of the individual finite basis orbits, giving one common power recurrence. relation_iff_minpoly identifies this recurrence with divisibility by X^n*(X^p-1) through actual aeval/minpoly, with positive p enforced in the outer theorem. Conversely divisibility gives the recurrence and hence every finite orbit and the real direct-sum equivalence from S3. The zero-dimensional space is not excluded by Nontrivial E or positive dimension assumptions. The infinite-module joint half reuses canonical projection naturality, actual four endomorphisms, exact intersection ranges, component uniqueness and simultaneous-intertwiner naturality; it does not require a common polynomial formula, consistent with S4.
